analysis_review: Played for years and it was a nice chill horror game to play with friends The latest update rolls around, and with it came animations with every single interaction, all of which slows down the game dramatically. The quick responsiveness of interactions with things like smudge sticks are a thing of the past with this new update. Now you have to wait a few seconds for everything, and in the heat of the moment against a ghost, those few seconds might as well be a few years. They also added character customization, but only in name. The items that the give you in the way of shirts, hairstyles, and so many other options that you would expect in a character creator are surprisingly limited. Think a max of 3 or 4 outfits regardless of how far you've made it into the game. I won't even get into the character models. This game still has a lot of the charm that made me fall in love with it back in 2021, but this update removed a large portion of that charm, and I honestly cannot recommend anyone spend their money on the game in its current state

Super disappointed at the new update. I've been playing this game religiously with my friends before it went to buns. The 'character customization' is just a preset of character models, you can't actually customize the skin, hair, face, etc. There's barely any clothing and most of the accessories you have to purchase with in-game currency. Why even bother with customization when there's barely any options? 'We'll add more in future updates.' yeah but TWO (2) identical pair of pants? You can't even add in a skirt or even shorts? Not to mention how janky both the clothing and models interact. Makes you think, why not just add more characters to the pool instead of this half-ass 'customization' update? Oh right, they probably want to make clothing or avatar items locked behind a real paywall like skins or something. Onto the gameplay, the animation is buns. No one asked for this. Even if they did, they weren't asking for a 5 second delay before using any item. Looking at it from another player's perspective is cool and all but having our own hands in the screen is just annoying. Even more so having the equipment shrunk to accommodate the stupid hands, I can barely read any of the equipments as is let alone having it the size of a peenar. And the journal? With the little light clip? The devs probably think it's a cute touch huh? It would've been cute if not for the journal being five feet away from your face. Another thing that disappointed me was how the devs reacted, specifically the art director. They said, and I quote, "The game is still plenty playable and once you get used to it, you might even forget some of the jank thats happening." Really? This is what happens when you have devs with their heads so far up their poopoo hole, they don't care about you or the community. And I doubt he's just one of the 'bad eggs', their whole team probably thinks they can get away with this too. I won't be surprised if they pull a yanderedev with how they're 6 years in development and still in early access. If you don't have this game and want to try it out, don't. Just go play a bootleg roblox game, it's free and probably has way less 'jank' than this.
